purpose: Protect experimentally achieved compact size, original native runtime, and measured CPU token speed while restoring actual task correctness and meaningful diverse generation. No experiment beyond the already running v94 verification.

historical_cpu_speed_reference.source: v89 frozen independent TEST benchmark. Historical speed measurements may define engineering baseline but never be used to retune or re-open that TEST for model selection.
historical_cpu_speed_reference.note: These are single-run 4-prompt CPU KV-cache figures; comparable CPU and settings required, repeat measurements with fresh TRAIN-only prompt suite. They do not certify current live speed.

acceptance_policy.size_ceiling_rule: All in archive <=0.700 bpp, ideally no extra bytes versus the immediately chosen compact baseline. Never increase storage merely for easier quality gains unless explicitly justified and still inside original <=0.700 bpp ceiling.
acceptance_policy.speed_rule: Preserve current measured compact-reference throughput under matched CPU, prompts and settings within reproducible benchmark uncertainty; 90% CB59 is a lower-bound fallback, not an automatic acceptance of 10% slowdown.
acceptance_policy.functional_rule: Improve or restore correctness relative to original FP32 on actual labeled questions; no meaningful domain loss, hallucination, repetition increase or semantic incoherence.
acceptance_policy.next_action: Finish observation of already running v94; read results relative to frozen reference. Do not train new weights, alter CB59/CB88/v92 archive, or start v95 until verified.
